notes.title: Lantern of Worlds - Storybook new update!
notes.notes:
Greetings and Salutations!

A new version of Lantern of Worlds - Storybook is ready!

In version 1.2, the UI of 'Lantern of Worlds - The First Quest' has been updated, and new locations have been added to the game.

Bugs have been send to the old bugs home, never to be seen again.

And work continues! 

Soon, you will be able to visit the Village of Myrr, in 'Lantern of Worlds - The First Quest,' and talk to the inhabitants there, and go on new adventures!

Best regards,

Fabian

notes.title: Version 1.1 ready. Maps overhaul and more!
notes.notes:
Greetings and Salutations!

Lantern of Worlds - Storybook version 1.1 is now ready!

- All the maps of Lantern of Worlds - The First Quest, have been redone!

- A new sea location has been added to Lantern of Worlds - The First Quest.

- Bugs have been terminated.

I wasn't too happy with the original maps of Lantern of Worlds - The First Quest, so I decided to redo them, and I am quite happy with the result!

Work will continue!

Best regards,

Fabian

notes.title: Update to version 0.5
notes.notes:
Greetings and salutations!

A new update for Lantern of Worlds - Storybook is available!
It adds new lighting, dice roll events, updated locations and Day 2 of the Tournament!

More updates coming soon!

notes.title: A new mayor update is ready!
notes.notes:
A mayor new update for 'Lantern of Worlds - The Story of Layla' is ready!

The update features updated maps, new characters, new stories, an improved combat system and more!

notes.title: Mayor Update! Better resolution, new features and more!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34711700/934772437c7ff8d8ca317d028d67fc102ae8da8b.png


Ahoy there pirates and sea dogs!

A new update for Lantern of Worlds - The story of Layla has been launched!

It features a better interface, better resolution, bug fixes and lots of added things. And more storylines are coming in the future!

So put on your pirate hat, take your scimitar and mug of rum, and embark with Layla on a great quest to save the world!

notes.title: Update 1.7 Live - Chose your Skills!
notes.notes:
A new update, 1.7 is live!

The update contains:

- Choose your own skills at the start of the adventure!

- Several minor fixes and improvements.

- Added lighting improvements.

- Updated skill screen.


Now, Layla is even better equipped to face the dangers of her adventure, and with your help, will surely win the day, and become the Queen of Pirates!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34711700/08f4a767b18e6a9f526e36980672afb0586b5540.jpg
